service:
[Unit]
Description=Deploy an already renewed mail host certificate
After=local-fs.target postfix.service dovecot.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
Group=celikpanel
UMask=0077
ExecStart=/usr/libexec/celikpanel/mail-renewal/a934256c2b3ec52a20498abd3b41ce3b38a3c13619d61712aab0b369e6f3b9f2/renew --process-pending
TimeoutStartSec=180s
KillMode=control-group
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=-/etc/ssl/celikpanel/_mail/host
timer:
[Unit]
Description=Check retained mail certificate renewal work

[Timer]
OnBootSec=30s
OnUnitInactiveSec=5min
RandomizedDelaySec=15s
AccuracySec=1s
Unit=celikpanel-mail-renewal.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
